rationale: The child is a congressional letter requesting enactment of a person-specific bill governing Major General Kuter's appointment, military status, compensation, reimbursement, and independence from military supervision. None of the candidates contains distinctive shared language, a parallel operative sequence, or substantially similar appointment and dual-status machinery. C01 is marginally closest only because it addresses relationships among federal officers and agencies, but its delegation and economic-control framework is materially different. C02 and C03 concern trade and trademark proclamations and provide no plausible drafting template.
